fact_previews: Hello Web App 2.0 is aimed at beginners with little-to-no programming experience, particularly those with HTML skills who want to learn back-end development.
The project includes a super generic project template that can be used to build unique applications such as a Twitter clone, an Instagram clone, a directory site, or a blog.
Updates in Hello Web App 2.0 include content updated for Python 3 and Django 2.0.
The two Hello Web App books are now bundled together as one big bundle, having been released originally as separate books.
Hello Web App 2.0 features all new videos that are designed to be gorgeous, easy to understand, and follow along with the paperback and eBook.
